personal.bio: Passionate Software Developer with 4.5+ years of experience specializing in full-stack development, distributed architectures, and legacy-to-cloud modernization within large-scale enterprise environments and capital markets. Proven track record of architecting concurrent Golang microservices, building Agentic AI & multimodal LLM systems, and delivering highly responsive, WCAG-compliant Angular applications. I thrive on clean architecture principles, robust DevSecOps practices, and delivering scalable, secure digital solutions.

description: Designed and developed scalable microservices using Golang, leveraging concurrency patterns (goroutines, channels) to handle high-throughput workloads.
Built and integrated RESTful APIs and third-party market data services, enabling real-time data streaming using Server-Sent Events (SSE), marking a key initiative for the team.
Developed and enhanced Angular applications, including major upgrades from v8/9 to v17/18, improving performance, maintainability, SEO, and ensuring long-term framework support.
Led migration of legacy applications from Java & Java Struts to Golang & Angular, improving system performance, scalability, and maintainability while quickly adapting to new technologies.
Enhanced web applications to achieve full compliance with AODA and WCAG 2.0 Level AA accessibility standards.
Developed secure applications adhering to enterprise standards, ensuring zero critical vulnerabilities across SAST, SCA, DAST, and API security audits.
Designed and implemented CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps for microservices, enabling automated build, test, deployment and release workflows.
Standardized and enhanced Helm-based deployment strategies for OpenShift, improving release consistency and operational efficiency.
Containerized and deployed applications on OpenShift, leveraging Kubernetes concepts such as orchestration, scaling, and resource management.
Owning and managing 10+ business-critical microservices (frontend and backend), handling end-to-end lifecycle including development, deployment, monitoring, and production support.
Collaborated in Agile teams, contributing to system design, code reviews, and performance optimization initiatives.
Contributed to full-stack development, bug resolution, and unit testing using Karma and Jasmine across capital markets applications.
Assisted in DB migrations (Oracle to Azure SQL) and automated test workflows using proprietary automation frameworks.
Authored comprehensive test cases to achieve 90%+ code coverage, ensuring application stability and production readiness.

projects.title: Conversational WhatsApp AI Sales Platform
projects.subtitle: Commercial Automotive Platform — Event-Driven Microservices & Intent Intelligence
projects.description: An event-driven Go/Gin microservice automating customer acquisition on WhatsApp with sub-50ms webhook response handling. Features an autonomous conversational agent with native tool calling (inventory search, interactive lists, image dispatch), dialect localization (including Malaysian Manglish), hierarchical memory (sliding-window + rolling summarization), Asynq/Redis-debounced lead scoring, voice-note ASR transcription, and automated bank transfer receipt verification.

projects.title: LLM-Powered Inventory ETL Pipeline
projects.subtitle: High-Throughput Batch Processing — Unstructured Data Ingestion & Normalization
projects.description: An asynchronous batch-processing pipeline designed to ingest noisy, unstructured automotive auction spreadsheets into normalized relational records. Employs prompt engineering with negative constraint mapping to eliminate price and variant hallucination, context-sticky date header propagation, and a concurrent goroutine chunking architecture (AI_CHUNK_SIZE, AI_CHUNK_CONCURRENCY_LIMIT) to process massive catalogs within LLM token and rate limits.

projects.title: Automated AI Vehicle Poster & Multi-Platform Social Publishing Engine
projects.subtitle: Autonomous Creative Studio — Multimodal Poster Generation & Omni-Channel Social Distribution
projects.description: A distributed cloud platform combining an intuitive web poster studio with a high-throughput Go backend for automated automotive marketing. Orchestrates multimodal AI generation for dynamic 2-page marketing posters (curated themes, macro detail framing), contextual AI caption & hashtag synthesis (Gemini 2.5 / Doubao LLM), and automated omni-channel publishing to Instagram, Facebook, Twitter/X (OAuth 2.0 PKCE), and LinkedIn via Redis Asynq worker pools, zero-disk direct OSS streaming, and real-time job telemetry.

projects.title: CDR (Canadian Depositary Receipts)
projects.subtitle: Capital Markets - Asset Pricing & Shareholder Voting
projects.description: A high-availability capital markets ecosystem managing real-time market pricing synchronization, shareholder voting for Corporate Actions, and administrative portal workflows. Features a dedicated Market Data Microservice integrated with Refinitiv (LSEG) APIs via WebSockets and Server-Sent Events (SSE) to stream low-latency pricing updates.

projects.title: go-gmail
projects.subtitle: Open Source Go Library
projects.description: A fluent, rate-limited Go wrapper for the official Gmail API. Enables building complex MIME emails with a clean, chainable API while automatically protecting your Google account from API quota blocks using intelligent rate limiting.
